qs.q: A neonate born with severe ventriculomegaly undergoes further neuroimaging to determine the exact structural cause prior to neurosurgery. What is a primary diagnostic advantage of fetal MRI over standard ultrasound in this evaluation?
o: It provides superior visualization of the underlying etiology
It allows continuous real-time bedside monitoring
It requires significantly less technician expertise
It eliminates all physiological scanning motion artifacts
qs.e: Magnetic resonance imaging offers superior visualization of the underlying etiology due to high soft-tissue resolution. Ultrasound, conversely, has lower resolution and is more operator-dependent.
